مقدمة
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
for fuel oil transfer 9forward) pump doublex filter as indicated (when Δ P = 0.6 bar) 
in the above titled block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 07 July 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.
